title: Simulink
description: Simulink — Universal Simulation Foundry (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.
body: Simulink is a real, publicly documented software tool relevant to Universal Simulation Foundry. In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Universal Simulation Foundry" aspires to do: Generates domain-specific simulation projects from mathematical models and system requirements..
